messages:
Alex: Noticed a weird divergence between p50/p95 in the region comparison widget and the endpoint breakdown for /v1/embeddings. Region view shows p50 ~18ms p95 ~45ms, endpoint breakdown shows p50 ~18ms p95 ~95ms. Anyone else?
Priya: I saw that spike this morning. The p99 is also different: region p99 ~120ms, endpoint p99 ~260ms. Suspect aggregation semantics.
Chen: Did we recently change histogram vs tdigest merges for the region panel? I recall an experiment to use bucketed histograms for faster rollups.
Taylor: Yes we enabled histogram-rollup for region-level metrics to reduce storage. That can inflate pctl if buckets are coarse.
Alex: Can you point to the flag/PR? We need to know if it's expected.
Taylor: PR #8952 toggles region_rollup=histogram for latency panels. It coalesces by 10ms buckets. For tight tails that can move p95 up.
Priya: But why would endpoint breakdown show an even bigger p95? Endpoint uses raw per-host tdigest, so it should be more accurate (lower). This suggests the region merge is underestimating while endpoint breakdown overestimates.
Chen: Another possibility: some requests are double-counted in endpoint breakdown due to proxy ingress tagging duplication. We had a duplicate-ingress bug last quarter.
Alex: Quick check: can someone run a raw sample p95 across the region (single tdigest) and per-endpoint raw p95? We need to know ground truth.
Taylor: Running quick ad-hoc query now, pulling 5m window.
Taylor: Raw single-tdigest region p95 = 48ms. Per-endpoint raw p95: ep-a 44ms ep-b 52ms ep-c 47ms.
Priya: So region raw matches the region panel-ish (48ms) but endpoint breakdown on dashboard showing 95ms is wrong. That points at a dashboard aggregation bug for endpoint panels.
Chen: On the endpoint panels we recently switched to "per-route bucketized rollup" to avoid exploding cardinality. Maybe buckets were re-used across diverse host tags causing cross-host mixing.
Alex: Can we inspect the endpoint panel query? Paste it here.
Taylor: Panel query snippet:
```
SELECT merge_histogram(lat_ms_hist, 100) AS hist
FROM metric_rollups
WHERE route='embeddings' AND tag='endpoint'
GROUP BY endpoint
```
It uses merge_histogram with 100 coarse bins.
Priya: That seems to be the culprit. merge_histogram with coarse bins loses resolution at tail and when computing pctl tends to round up. For sparse endpoints it can jump a lot.
Chen: Proposed immediate mitigation: change endpoint panels to use merge_tdigest (single digest merge) for the pctl calc while we evaluate histogram storage tradeoffs.
Alex: Agreed. Also add sample_count next to pctl on endpoint panels so we can eyeball low-sample noise.
Taylor: I can open a hotfix to change the aggregation mode on the endpoint dashboard to merge_tdigest for pctl metrics. Will feature-flag it.
ops-bot: alert: dashboard-config-change requested by Taylor at 1733337799 (feature-flag: endpoint-tdigest=true)
Priya: After toggle canary to 5% of dashboards, re-run the queries and confirm p95 converges within 10ms of raw single-tdigest.
Taylor: Canary applied to staging dashboards. Staging endpoint p95 now shows ep-a 46ms ep-b 50ms ep-c 49ms. Matches raw.
Chen: Nice. For longer term we should document tradeoffs between histogram rollups (storage/cost) and tdigest accuracy in docs and add a UX hint on panels when histograms are used.
Alex: Also we should add a diagnostic overlay: when pctl difference between region and endpoint > 30% show a "merge mode mismatch" badge with link to drilldown.
Priya: I'll file ENG-9021: dashboard-aggregation-playbook + UX flag.
Taylor: Hotfix PR opened, will push to prod behind feature-flag after approval. ETA 20m.
Alex: Good work. Once prod canary shows alignment let's close and follow up with a retro note on histograms vs tdigest for dashboard owners.
Taylor: Will post results here after prod canary.
Taylor: Prod canary result: endpoint p95 now aligned to 49-52ms, region p95 48ms, p99s within 10% as well. Sample counts visible. Rolling feature-flag to 100%.
ops-bot: deploy: dashboard-config updated (feature-flag:endpoint-tdigest=true) at 1733337812
Alex: Closing. Lesson: aggregation format matters. UX needs to surface merge semantics and sample-counts. Thanks all.
